t: Saying it is the easy half
a: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
p: Inna-lladhīna qālū rabbuna-llāhu thumma-staqāmū fa-lā khawfun ʿalayhim wa lā hum yaḥzanūn.
m: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allāh," and then remained on a right course - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
